reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: A wonderful daily gel cleanser that purifies the skin without stripping away its natural moisture. The low pH formula feels incredibly gentle, while the subtle tea tree infusion helps control oil and prevent breakouts. It leaves the face feeling clean, refreshed, and perfectly balanced.
reviews.zh: 一款好正嘅日常用嘅 gel 潔面，可以清潔皮膚但唔會帶走本身嘅水分。Low pH 配方感覺好溫和，淡淡嘅茶樹成分仲可以控油同預防爆瘡。用完之後塊面感覺乾淨、清爽又剛剛好平衡返。

reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: My all time favorite cleanser for when my skin is irritated. It features tea tree oil and it really helps with spot treatment and this is my third repurchase. However, also because of the tea tree, it is too drying to use everyday so I only use this cleanser when I need a spot treatment.
reviews.zh: 我皮膚敏感嘅時候永遠嘅首選潔面。佢有茶樹油，真係好幫到手處理暗瘡，已經係第三次回購。不過都係因為有茶樹，所以唔適合日日用，否則會太乾，所以我只會喺需要處理暗瘡嘅時候先用佢。

reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: Fourth time purchasing this! I’ve been using it for over a year and my sister also loved it after using it once. There is a slightly strong smell but I personally like it since it smells fresh. This was another product that helped sooth my flared up all. It doesn’t leave your skin feeling stripped and it’s quite moisturizing, that is until my face is dry so I do apply product right after I dry. I do recommend for sensitive skin or acne prone skin. I did notice however how my old bottle didn’t include the ingredient sodium chloride but the rest of the ingredients were the same, so I don’t know if they just started using it in their formula.
reviews.zh: 第四次回購！用咗超過一年，俾我阿妹用過一次之後佢都好鍾意。有少少重嘅味道，不過我自己就幾鍾意，因為聞落好清新。呢隻都係幫到我舒緩皮膚爆發嘅產品之一。洗完之後皮膚唔會有被刮走水份嘅感覺，而且都好保濕，不過到我塊面乾嘅時候就會即刻補返護膚品。我會推薦畀敏感肌或者暗瘡肌用。但我都留意到我舊嗰樽冇 sodium chloride 呢隻成分，其他成分都一樣，所以唔知係咪佢哋開始加入新配方。

reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: Great product! Love the texture. The product has a strong tea tree smell, so beware if you don't like that smell. I love how gentle is cleanser is. It's not stripping at all! Note, this product does little to control excess sebum. But I guess that's why it's gentle. Overall, like it!
reviews.zh: 好正嘅產品！好鍾意佢嘅質地。茶樹味好重，唔鍾意呢個味嘅人要留意。我好鍾意佢點解可以咁溫和，絕對唔會有刮水感！留意，呢隻產品控油效果就真係麻麻，但溫和就溫和喺度。整體嚟講，鍾意！

reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: At first I was unsure of if I would like this cleanser due to the fact that I am very sensitive and dry skin. But let me tell you it does not disappoint. Every time I use it my skin feels clean but also moisturized. If they come with a bigger format I will be buying it for sure.
reviews.zh: 本來我係比較敏感嘅乾性肌，所以一開始都唔太 sure 鍾唔鍾意呢隻潔面。但佢真係冇令我失望。每次用完之後，皮膚感覺乾淨得嚟又保濕。如果有再大支裝嘅版本我一定會回購。

reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: Este es el jabón que siempre uso, he probado demasiados y siempre regreso a el, primero es super económico, tiene consistencia en gel, es para todo tipo de piel ya que regula tu ph, se los recomiendo mucho, siento mi cara super fresca y no la deja tirante, además si sufres de acné, te ayuda a calmar la zona irritada
reviews.zh: 呢隻係我一直用緊嘅潔面，試過好多隻最後都返轉頭用返佢。首先超抵用，gel 質地，適合所有膚質因為可以調節 pH，超級推薦。用完之後塊面超清爽又唔會繃緊，而且如果你係暗瘡肌，仲可以幫到舒緩受刺激嘅位置。

reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: This is my favorite cleanser of all time and have gone through several bottles. It is very gentle but still cleanses well. It smells of tea tree but as I enjoy this scent, I do not mind at all but would like to warn anyone who might be sensitive to it.
reviews.zh: 呢隻係我人生最鍾意嘅潔面，已經用完幾支。非常溫和但清潔力都夠。聞落有茶樹味，我自己鍾意呢個味所以完全冇所謂，不過都想提一提可能會對呢個味敏感嘅人。

reviews.shade: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml
reviews.text: I have oily combination/ acne- pro skin and I wanted to love this so much, but it ended up irritating my face, and making me feel dry ;:( but then again I think my Face ID just very sensitive. I love the smell though
reviews.zh: 我係油性混合／暗瘡肌，本來好想愛上呢隻，但結果係刺激到我塊面，搞到我覺得好乾；;( 不過我又覺得可能只係我塊面真係太敏感。我就係鍾意個味道。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
